text:
alex: Quick heads-up — we need a hotfix for 2.4.6 -> 2.4.7. Token-sync regression landed in prod. Target cutover today 18:00 UTC. Minimal diff, please avoid migrations. Ping when you have PRs. :exclamation:

maya: I can open the PR now. I'll branch off release/2.4.7-hotfix and cherry-pick the fix commit. Which hash should I pick?

liam: Use commit `abc1234f` from main — it's the small change. I'll queue the CI smoke ride and run integration after build. ETA ~30m.

riley: I'll add a changelog entry and bump the package patch. Short note only: "fix: token sync mismatch in streaming".

alex: perfect. Keep it extremely small: only bump, changelog, and the cherry-pick. No feature flags or migrations. `git checkout -b release/2.4.7-hotfix && git cherry-pick -x abc1234f`

maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/release/2.4.7-hotfix — requesting reviews from @liam and @riley. Title: "chore(release): 2.4.7 hotfix (token sync)"

liam: reviewing now, will comment on CI flakes. If green I can merge and push the tag.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled for release/2.4.7-hotfix at 2025-11-02T18:00:00Z. Auto-rollback on error enabled.

riley: docs/changelog PR up: one-line entry. @maya can you confirm the package version bump matches the tag you plan to push?

maya: bump in `setup.py` + `version.txt` to 2.4.7, yes. I will not touch any other files.

alex: thumbs up. After merge, trigger canary on staging then promote if no errors in 15m. @liam you have rollout.

liam: got it. I'll watch logs and abort if error rate > 0.5%. Will post updates here.

maya: merged. tagging `v2.4.7` and pushing. build is starting.

liam: build green, canary running.

liam: canary healthy for 20m, promoting now.

release-bot: Promotion complete. Prod deploy finished at 2025-11-02T18:17:30Z :rocket:

alex: awesome work everyone — small and surgical. I'll follow up for retro notes. :tada:
